canonical_project: BONC Horinger Intelligent Computing Center (东方国信和林格尔智算中心)
owner: BONC Software Co., Ltd. (东方国信, 300166.SZ)
notes: New project (not in prior CN registry). Total investment 3.0B CNY; 8 data-center buildings; 10,000 racks (1万个数据机柜) => 60 MW at 6kW/rack. DeepSeek full models deployed on its self-developed 幕僚智数 large-model training/inference platform by 2025-02. Located in Horinger New District (东数西算 Horinger cluster). Source: Inner Mongolia Enterprise Federation reprint of 青橙融媒 (Hohhot official media).
